text: The Index listed Victor Hugo's Les Misérables with a decree dated 20 June 1864. On 3 April 1961 Spanish censors denied a publisher's request to print the novel because it was registered on the Church's Index under that decree, and a censor maintained the refusal in March 1963.
meta_description: Les Misérables by Victor Hugo: listed on the Index by decree of 20 June 1864; Spanish censors refused a print request in 1961 and again in 1963.
